name: Gate Pose
description: Kneeling side bend with one leg extended out to the side.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Kneel upright with your knees hip-width apart.
Stretch one leg out to the side, foot flat, in line with the kneeling knee.

keyframes.name: Kneel tall
keyframes.cue: Kneel with the hips over the knees.

keyframes.name: Lift the right knee out
keyframes.cue: Keep the left knee down and lift the right knee out to the side.

keyframes.name: Step the right foot out
keyframes.cue: Plant the right foot out to the side, knee over the ankle.

keyframes.name: Gate Pose
keyframes.cue: Straighten the right leg, then bend toward it with the left arm overhead.

keyframes.name: Step the right foot out
keyframes.cue: Come up and bend the right knee.

keyframes.name: Lift the right knee out
keyframes.cue: Lift the right foot and bring the knee back under the hip.

cues: Keep the hips over the kneeling knee.
Lengthen the side body before bending.
